mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses discount rates and increases equity present values, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is always active as FEDFUNDS is a continuous monetary policy signal.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.5% regimes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 4.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS > 4.5% regimes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% and housing starts (HOUST) above 850.0 thousand units signal tight labor markets and strong housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in UNRATE < 4.0 AND HOUST > 850.0 regimes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic contraction and weak consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in UNRATE > 5.0% regimes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 850.0 thousand units signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active as HOUST is a continuous demand indicator.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in HOUST > 850.0 regimes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This horizon aligns with quarterly supply chain dynamics.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in INDPRO < 95.0 regimes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 and housing starts (HOUST) above 850.0 thousand units signal robust economic activity across supply and demand sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through synchronized growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in INDPRO > 95.0 AND HOUST > 850.0 regimes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
